PEN-6280 staging-rule liveness fixture. NOT A CREDENTIAL.

The line below is a locally generated random string. It authenticates
nothing, was never issued by any system, and is not derived from anything
real. It exists so the warn-only `opaque-high-entropy-token` rule in
.gitleaks-staging.toml has a known-positive input in this repository.

It is deliberately BARE and deliberately carries no binding name, because
that is the exact population the rule exists to reach and the exact
population gitleaks' default rules do NOT reach -- measured, the default
rules miss this file and the staging rule hits it.

Because both scans are diff-aware, this fires ONLY in the pull request whose
commit range touches this file. Editing it will light up the staging step
again; that is intended and is how the rule's liveness is re-checked.
